chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 436 – The Fragment Map’s Secret: A Race in the Chaotic Star Sea
chapter_meta_description: The Profound Bone Saint flees with a fragment map. Han Li discovers his own map has transformed into a golden compass pointing to a secret destination. A cry for help from a familiar sect!
og_title: The Map Points Northwest… And So Does Trouble
og_description: Han Li recovers from the underground battle and finds his treasure map has become a ticking clock. A chance encounter with a Sublime Sound Sect disciple drags him into a local feud.
twitter_title: The Fragment Map Awakens – A New Game Begins
twitter_description: The Profound Bone Saint’s secret is out! Han Li holds a golden compass map. But a cry for help from a familiar voice means his plans just got complicated.

lore_anchors.definition: A composite artifact formed from over a dozen rare materials; it functions as a seal for great formations or entities beneath an ancient ruin.
The self-proclaimed former master of the founder of Extreme Yin Island; a ‘thousand-year-old ghost’ who exists as a Profound Soul Body.
A special undead existence where a cultivator disperses their Nascent Soul to bypass physical lifespan limits.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the Profound Bone Saint care so much about a small piece of silk?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a fragment of a treasure map. In the xianxia world, such maps are often keys to hidden legacies, and he has a time limit to use it before someone else does.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just ignore the map and continue with his own business?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is constantly weighing risk vs. reward. The map’s transformation into a compass suggests a massive payoff, and the old fiend’s excitement confirms it’s worth the detour.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Venom Dragon Society?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A hostile faction in the Chaotic Star Sea, likely a rival power to the Sublime Sound Sect. Their arrival signals that local politics are about to get very complicated for Han Li.
